reason: A local-first journaling assistant that captures, lightly edits, organizes, and undoes Markdown journal entries with optional image copying in a user-selected folder.

summaries.zh: 一款本地优先的日志助手，可在用户选择的文件夹中捕获、润色、整理和撤销 Markdown 日志条目，并可复制相关图片。
summaries.en: A local-first journaling assistant that captures, lightly edits, organizes, and undoes Markdown entries in a user-selected folder while optionally copying related images.

capabilities: Reads and writes Markdown journal files in a user-selected local folder
Copies images from the latest direct user message into journal image directories
Uses a model to lightly polish explicit journal text and organize daily entries
Provides confirmation previews and guarded undo for applied mutations
